title: ServiceSignalParams
description: service.signal's params: a signal for a run's instance.

apiVersion.description: The version of the control API the request is written to.

target.description: The knowledge base whose stack documents name the service's image, and whose stack the instance belongs to: stack.stop of it removes the instance too.

runtime.description: The container runtime to ask, as --runtime names it. Absent: the one the stack's record names, else the first installed one.

signal.description: term: SIGTERM, and SIGKILL 15 seconds later if it has not exited. kill: SIGKILL, so nothing it would settle on the way out is settled.
